name: Emily — six ailes déployées, saison 2
prompt: Use case: identity-preserving static alternate-form sprite. Create ONE isolated full-body EMILY from Hazbin Hotel Season 2 in her SIX-WINGED floating presentation, as directly shown in these official Prime Video frames. Image 1, at200 seconds of the official Egg Boiz compilation, governs her complete floating silhouette, all three pairs of deployed feathered wings, crown-like halo, rounded dress hem and pointed feet. Image 2, at195 seconds, governs her face, large lavender-blue eyes with dark lashes, pale grey-lavender skin, soft pale lilac hair with asymmetrical fringe, and small white cheek freckles. Image 3, at235 seconds, corroborates the complete outline and lower legs/feet. Preserve her short puff sleeves, pale lilac dress, small dark four-petal chest emblem, and the darker lavender pointed zigzag-and-diamond hem pattern. She has exactly SIX feathered wings: three separate layered pairs emerging behind her torso, with long narrow pale feathers, all tips fully visible and distinct. Do not mistake long hair for another wing or add extra limbs. Her luminous pale crown halo has the same small upright droplet points as the reference. Pose: calmly floating upright, slightly three-quarter facing right, hands gently open at her sides and feet just below the hem, peaceful alert expression. This is a static archive illustration of the already documented winged state, not a new costume or a redesign. Crisp black/dark-lavender 2D series-style animation outlines, flat opaque cel colors and minimal reference-consistent shadows. Use a wide enough canvas to leave at least 7 percent real transparent margin around ALL six wings, halo and feet. True transparent RGBA background, no magical aura or broad glow, no ground, shadow, clouds, scenery, companions, eggs, lettering, captions, logos, frame, duplicate views or animation frames.

findings: Six ailes distinctes, trois paires entières visibles ; halo, coiffure et motif de robe comparés aux sources officielles.
